howToPlay: Use the Shadow Realm from the Vanish gadget and your Super to close the distance to enemies effectively. Once near, use your high-damage basic attacks to secure eliminations before retreating safely. Utilize the teleportation from your Super or the Repot gadget to surprise opponents and stay mobile.
gears: Damage is essential for increasing your elimination potential, while Speed helps you maneuver through bushes. Gadget Cooldown is highly recommended to frequently use your Vanish and Repot gadgets for better survivability and positioning.
trait: This brawler suits a patient player who enjoys ambushing enemies and managing burst movement abilities to control the flow of combat.
